title: Does ERPNext care about CRM module anymore?

posts.cooked:
I haven’t seen many (any?) changes to the ERPNext CRM module in a while.

Has the team abandoned this?

I know there is now a Frappe CRM app, but the problem with that is that it has an entirely different interface than the rest of the ERPnext modules…

I use the standard ERPNext CRM module in my business, and have no interest in dealing with a separate interface when the sales team has to use the standard ERPNext modules (and therefore a different interface that the Frappe CRM app) for other things, anyway…

posts.name: Diamo
posts.cooked:
It was decided some time ago that nothing will be incorporated into the old CRM module. In fact, as announced at the conference, everything will migrate to Frappe UI.

It’s very easy to use, by the way, even easier than the old one.
